title: Here’s Where to Buy New York Mets Tickets for ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Night Online
summary: If you're a KPop Demon Hunters fans in NYC, then you could get a free HUNTR/X jersey at the Nationals-Mets game in Queens.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With the New York Yankees putting on a KPop Demon Hunters Night for fans on Tuesday (Aug. 11), the special night also goes from The Bronx to Queens with the New York Mets a few days later. The team is also hosting their own KPop Demon Hunters Night , in partnership with Netflix. If you’re one of the first 15,000 fans to attend the Nationals-Mets game, then you can get a limited-edition KPDH x MLB Mets HUNTR/X jersey for free — just for attending.

On Saturday (Aug. 15), KPop Demon Hunters Night (also known as Korean Heritage Night) features the Washington Nationals going head-to-head against the New York Mets at Citi Field in Queens, New York. First pitch is at 4:10 p.m. ET.

Shop New York Mets Tickets at Ticketmaster

As for the jersey, the Mets logo is on the front and left sleeve, while the back features fictional K-pop trio HUNTR/X — Zoey, Rumi and Mira.

View this post on Instagram

Tickets to the game first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the online retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option to resell tickets.

However, the game may be very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute New York Mets tickets online is through third-party retailer sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for the game. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Who Is Performing for KPop Demon Hunters Night During the Mets Game?

Before the game starts, Korean-American singer Kevin Woo , who was the singing voice for Mystery Saja in KPop Demon Hunters , is set to perform his new single, “Ain’t No Party.”
